title: The Creeping Feeling You Can Never Shake
topic: Disturbing human brain glitches and illusions science cannot explain
script: Imagine you're at the edge of a cliff, staring into the void. You feel the wind rushing past, and yet, you know you can't fall. The ground beneath your feet is solid, yet the sense of vertigo is overwhelming. It's as if your brain is playing a cruel trick on you. But what if your brain is not just playing a trick? What if it's actually trying to tell you something? But what if you can't listen? What if the only way to escape is to stare into the void... and get lost in your own mind forever?
